verdict.rationale: No evidence documents an explicit bulk-edit feature or batch API. Bulk work is only implied: the GraphQL API and SDKs allow programmatic interaction with workflows, agents can run programmatically, and an example prompt ('Score our open deals and send proposals to anyone above 80%') suggests an agent acting across many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch item operations (multi-item update, delete or move), batch API mutations or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven bulk changes.
